actions.reason: K6_C0002 has an interpretable transcriptomic phenotype (coordinated immune/interferon down-regulation with OXPHOS/fatty-acid up-regulation, FDR q 0.001), but membership is broadly unsupported: all four native geometries show negative mean silhouettes (CT -0.162, RNA -0.041, WSI -0.183, WXS -0.023) with high negative fractions, and the candidate sits closer to competing sets. Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: pair evidence against K6_C0003 (silhouettes 0.066/0.078/0.141/0.049, negative fractions up to 0.39), K6_C0005 (0.116/0.087/0.026/0.100, up to 0.38), and K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 (0.062/0.087/0.150/0.237, up to 0.26) is uniformly weak with substantial overlap. No split is supported (partition screen shows candidate_k=1 with no internal subdivision signal). Confounder evidence is null but nonsignificance does not establish absence of confounding. With broadly unsupported membership, weak/merge-compatible boundaries, and no supported structural revision, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.

K6_C0003 has an interpretable inflammatory/immune-activated transcriptomic phenotype (interferon gamma/alpha, allograft rejection, TNFA/NFKB, IL6/JAK/STAT3 up-regulation, FDR q 0.001), but membership representation is materially conflicting: CT (0.148) and WSI (0.165) show positive separation while RNA (-0.053) and WXS (-0.135, 81% negative) show none. Its decision-relevant boundaries are weak and merge-compatible: pair evidence against K6_C0002 (silhouettes 0.066/0.078/0.141/0.049, negative fractions up to 0.39), K6_C0005 (0.197/0.093/0.160/0.032, WXS negative fraction 0.368), and K6_C0001_M_K6_C0004 (0.058/0.046/0.093/0.135, negative fractions up to 0.33) is weak-to-modest with substantial overlap. Confounder evidence shows significant association with tissue source site (Cramer's V 0.546) and CT slice thickness/z-spacing (epsilon-squared 0.261/0.265, q ~7e-07), which remain plausible candidate-specific alternative explanations for membership. No split is supported (candidate_k=1, no internal subdivision signal). With conflicting membership, weak/merge-compatible boundaries, and a plausible technical explanation, the candidate lacks defensible discovery value.
